ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund due. Advise rider that cancellation after 3 minutes of matching is chargeable and that driver lateness is not a published ground for a fee waiver (route any goodwill request to RydeHELP within 30 days per NS-7).

rejected_claims.reason: NS-4 makes cancellation after 3 minutes of matching chargeable (here 3 min 20 s, [F2]); Ryde publishes no ETA-based free-cancellation rule, so the driver's 2,501 m distance [F1] does not waive the $6.61 fee. Rider's remedy is a discretionary RydeHELP appeal within 30 days (NS-7).
